title: Keyfactor EJBCA through 9.3.3 performs insufficient authorization checks when self-renewing a client certificate via…
description: Keyfactor EJBCA versions through 9.3.3 have a vulnerability where insufficient authorization checks occur during client certificate self-renewal via the RA User Interface. An authenticated remote user with a valid client certificate and RA UI access can renew their certificate even if policy or profile settings should prevent it.
